sourceOfTruth.detailsTaskPresentation: details disclosure with literal Markdown body, not a checkbox

mutation.before:
# Nested tasks

> - [ ] Quoted task

<details open>
<summary>More</summary>
- [ ] Detailed task
</details>
mutation.after:
# Nested tasks

> - [x] Quoted task

<details open>
<summary>More</summary>
- [ ] Detailed task
</details>

interactionChannels.native: Computer Use physical ArrowDown, Enter, Source/Rendered, and blockquote task click

boundary: Native retains only the blockquote mutation exposed by Electron. The prior Native-only multiline-details mutation was reverted because both surfaces keep raw HTML details bodies literal. Web's sanitize allowlist now preserves the existing details disclosure. Paired pixels and keyboard activation remain open.
